easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.
